select t.date, t.category_id, t.description, t.value, a.bank, a.name as account_name
from public.transactions t
left join public.accounts a on a.id::text = t.account_id
where t.owner_id = $1::uuid
  and t.deleted = false
  and t.type = 'despesa'
  and t.category_id not in ('aplicacao-investimentos','resgate-investimentos','previdencia','reserva-emergencia','projetos-vida','independencia-financeira')
  and t.date >= $2::date
  and t.date <= $3::date
  and (nullif($4::text, '') is null or a.bank ilike '%' || $4 || '%')
  and ($5::boolean is not true or a.type = 'credito')
order by t.date desc;

with periodo as (
  select generate_series($2::date, $3::date, interval '1 month')::date as mes_ref
),
meses as (
  select extract(year from mes_ref)::int as ano,
         extract(month from mes_ref)::int - 1 as mes_idx
  from periodo
),
conta as (
  select op.user_id from public.owner_profiles op where op.id = $1::uuid
),
todos_owners as (
  select op.id from public.owner_profiles op where op.user_id = (select user_id from conta)
),
cats_conjuntas as (
  select distinct bjc.category_id
  from public.budget_joint_categories bjc
  where bjc.user_id = (select user_id from conta)
    and bjc.year between extract(year from $2::date)::int and extract(year from $3::date)::int
),
base as (
  select b.category_id, b.planned_value, b.year, b.month
  from public.budgets b
  where b.owner_id = $1::uuid
     or (b.category_id in (select category_id from cats_conjuntas)
         and b.owner_id in (select id from todos_owners))
)
select
  base.category_id,
  sum(base.planned_value) as planejado,
  (base.category_id in (select category_id from cats_conjuntas)) as categoria_conjunta
from base
join meses m on base.year = m.ano and base.month = m.mes_idx
group by base.category_id
order by base.category_id;

with periodo as (
  select date_trunc('month', $2::date) as mes_inicio, date_trunc('month', $3::date) as mes_fim
),
conta as (
  select op.user_id from public.owner_profiles op where op.id = $1::uuid
),
todos_owners as (
  select op.id from public.owner_profiles op where op.user_id = (select user_id from conta)
),
cats_conjuntas as (
  select distinct bjc.category_id
  from public.budget_joint_categories bjc
  where bjc.user_id = (select user_id from conta)
    and bjc.year between extract(year from $2::date)::int and extract(year from $3::date)::int
),
tx_efetiva as (
  select
    t.category_id, t.type, t.value,
    a.type as account_type,
    case
      when a.type = 'credito' and t.payment_date is not null then date_trunc('month', t.payment_date)
      when a.type = 'credito' and a.closing_day is not null then
        date_trunc('month',
          (case when extract(day from t.date) > a.closing_day then t.date + interval '1 month' else t.date end)
          + (case when a.due_day is not null and a.due_day <= a.closing_day then interval '1 month' else interval '0 month' end)
        )
      else date_trunc('month', t.date)
    end as mes_efetivo
  from public.transactions t
  left join public.accounts a on a.id::text = t.account_id
  where (t.owner_id = $1::uuid
         or (t.category_id in (select category_id from cats_conjuntas)
             and t.owner_id in (select id from todos_owners)))
  and t.deleted = false
    and t.category_id <> 'pagamento-fatura-cartao'
),
filtrado as (
  select tx.* from tx_efetiva tx, periodo p
  where tx.mes_efetivo >= p.mes_inicio and tx.mes_efetivo <= p.mes_fim
),
fluxo as (
  select
    coalesce(sum(case when type='receita' then abs(value) else 0 end),0) as receitas,
    coalesce(sum(case when type='despesa' and coalesce(account_type,'') <> 'credito'
                       and category_id not in ('aplicacao-investimentos','resgate-investimentos','previdencia','reserva-emergencia','projetos-vida','independencia-financeira')
                  then abs(value) else 0 end),0) as a_vista,
    coalesce(sum(case when type='despesa' and account_type = 'credito'
                       and category_id not in ('aplicacao-investimentos','resgate-investimentos','previdencia','reserva-emergencia','projetos-vida','independencia-financeira')
                  then abs(value) else 0 end),0) as cartao,
    coalesce(sum(case when category_id in ('reserva-emergencia','projetos-vida','independencia-financeira','previdencia','aplicacao-investimentos') then abs(value) else 0 end),0) as total_aplicado,
    coalesce(sum(case when category_id = 'resgate-investimentos' then abs(value) else 0 end),0) as total_resgatado
  from filtrado
),
planejado_raw as (
  select b.category_id, sum(b.planned_value) as planejado
  from public.budgets b
  join (select generate_series($2::date, $3::date, interval '1 month')::date as mes_ref) per on true
  where (b.owner_id = $1::uuid
         or (b.category_id in (select category_id from cats_conjuntas)
             and b.owner_id in (select id from todos_owners)))
    and b.year = extract(year from per.mes_ref)::int
    and b.month = extract(month from per.mes_ref)::int - 1
  group by b.category_id
)
select 'fluxo'::text as linha, null::text as category_id, null::numeric as planejado,
       receitas, a_vista, cartao, total_aplicado, total_resgatado
from fluxo
union all
select 'planejado'::text, category_id, planejado, null::numeric, null::numeric, null::numeric, null::numeric, null::numeric
from planejado_raw;

  and t.date >= $2::date
  and t.date <= $3::date;

with periodo as (
  select date_trunc('month', $2::date) as mes_inicio, date_trunc('month', $3::date) as mes_fim
),
conta as (
  select op.user_id from public.owner_profiles op where op.id = $1::uuid
),
todos_owners as (
  select op.id from public.owner_profiles op where op.user_id = (select user_id from conta)
),
cats_conjuntas as (
  select distinct bjc.category_id
  from public.budget_joint_categories bjc
  where bjc.user_id = (select user_id from conta)
    and bjc.year between extract(year from $2::date)::int and extract(year from $3::date)::int
),
tx_efetiva as (
  select
    t.category_id, t.type, t.value,
    a.type as account_type,
    case
      when a.type = 'credito' and t.payment_date is not null then date_trunc('month', t.payment_date)
      when a.type = 'credito' and a.closing_day is not null then
        date_trunc('month',
          (case when extract(day from t.date) > a.closing_day then t.date + interval '1 month' else t.date end)
          + (case when a.due_day is not null and a.due_day <= a.closing_day then interval '1 month' else interval '0 month' end)
        )
      else date_trunc('month', t.date)
    end as mes_efetivo
  from public.transactions t
  left join public.accounts a on a.id::text = t.account_id
  where (t.owner_id = $1::uuid
         or (t.category_id in (select category_id from cats_conjuntas)
             and t.owner_id in (select id from todos_owners)))
  and t.deleted = false
    and t.category_id <> 'pagamento-fatura-cartao'
),
filtrado as (
  select tx.* from tx_efetiva tx, periodo p
  where tx.mes_efetivo >= p.mes_inicio and tx.mes_efetivo <= p.mes_fim
),
fluxo as (
  select
    coalesce(sum(case when type='receita' then abs(value) else 0 end),0) as receitas,
    coalesce(sum(case when type='despesa' and coalesce(account_type,'') <> 'credito'
                       and category_id not in ('aplicacao-investimentos','resgate-investimentos','previdencia','reserva-emergencia','projetos-vida','independencia-financeira')
                  then abs(value) else 0 end),0) as a_vista,
    coalesce(sum(case when type='despesa' and account_type = 'credito'
                       and category_id not in ('aplicacao-investimentos','resgate-investimentos','previdencia','reserva-emergencia','projetos-vida','independencia-financeira')
                  then abs(value) else 0 end),0) as cartao,
    coalesce(sum(case when category_id in ('reserva-emergencia','projetos-vida','independencia-financeira','previdencia','aplicacao-investimentos') then abs(value) else 0 end),0) as total_aplicado,
    coalesce(sum(case when category_id = 'resgate-investimentos' then abs(value) else 0 end),0) as total_resgatado
  from filtrado
),
planejado_raw as (
  select b.category_id, sum(b.planned_value) as planejado
  from public.budgets b
  join (select generate_series($2::date, $3::date, interval '1 month')::date as mes_ref) per on true
  where (b.owner_id = $1::uuid
         or (b.category_id in (select category_id from cats_conjuntas)
             and b.owner_id in (select id from todos_owners)))
    and b.year = extract(year from per.mes_ref)::int
    and b.month = extract(month from per.mes_ref)::int - 1
  group by b.category_id
)
select 'fluxo'::text as linha, null::text as category_id, null::numeric as planejado,
       receitas, a_vista, cartao, total_aplicado, total_resgatado
from fluxo
union all
select 'planejado'::text, category_id, planejado, null::numeric, null::numeric, null::numeric, null::numeric, null::numeric
from planejado_raw;
